game_concept: A full-screen welcome cinematic introduces LogiCade and its learning journey.
theme: The Kingdom – Market Square: a bustling cobbled market square
core_gameplay_loop: Watch the full-screen LogiCade prologue; completion unlocks the flowchart stage.
player_objective: Watch the LogiCade prologue to completion before entering the first learning challenge.
controls: Full-screen video; no pause or skip controls. Click only if sound autoplay is blocked.
win_condition: The prologue video reaches its end.
lose_condition: The video is closed before completion.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Swap Switch' (Week 1 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Market Square'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
